_coverage.title: book_appointment: offer two or three open times, let the patient pick one, repeat the day, time and location back, and book only after they confirm ("yes", "that works").

name: offer_times_after_slot_search_no_booking_yet
input: Yeah, Elm Street, sometime next week in the morning.

conversation.content: Hi, I need to schedule my annual physical sometime next week.
Sure, I can help with that. To be sure I’m working with the right chart, what’s your full name and date of birth?
Thanks, one moment while I pull up your chart.
You’re all set in our system. Do you prefer Elm Street or Riverside, and mornings or afternoons next week for your annual physical?
Yeah, Elm Street, sometime next week in the morning.

grading_criteria: The assistant must call find_open_slots with visitType="annual_physical", location="elm_street" or "any" (but only offer Elm Street slots), and a date range covering "next week". It must reply by offering two or three concrete open times taken from the tool output (e.g., "Mon 9:00, Tue 9:20, or Thu 10:40 at Elm Street"), and ask the patient which one they want. It must not call book_appointment yet and must not imply that anything is already booked.

checks.used_slot_times_only: Did the assistant only offer times that appear in the find_open_slots result?
checks.offered_two_or_three_times: Did the assistant offer exactly two or three distinct appointment options, not just one or a long list?
checks.no_booking_yet: Did the assistant avoid calling book_appointment or stating that an appointment is booked in this turn?
